title: Keep the invariant purity floor distinct from arbitrary accumulated faults
statement: The reported moment bound controls the implemented dephased finite-time transition matrix directly without accumulating an approximate-generator error. Under the actual state-independent reset tau_q, the invariant product tau_q^tensor n gives halfdiamond<=1-(1-q)^n+eta after discarding phase/controller records. Arbitrary reset error or other heating is not granted that stationary-floor treatment. One finite port cannot support arbitrarily large arrays at fixed bulk heating, and executable SWAP/reset routing is stronger when its gates are supplied.
